critical_code_review_comments: WiringBrain.jsx runs a setNow(performance.now()) on every RAF frame which triggers a full component re-render each frame (~60fps). With only 3 pulses this is fine, but the entire SVG (nodes + all edges + memoized-by-inline-object edgeStyle callbacks) re-renders 60x/s. Consider useRef + direct DOM cx/cy updates via refs or a dedicated pulse subcomponent to avoid re-rendering static nodes/edges.
isEdgeActive/isOutEdgeActive iterate pulses on every path render, giving O(edges * pulses) work per frame; acceptable at current sizes but worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WiringBrain uses RAF loop driving setNow(); pulses have startTime, computed cx/cy each frame. To count traveling dots in tests, query svg circles with r='3.5' and style containing 'drop-shadow'.
